fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance's Permanent Secretary wrote on 2025-12-17 that the government is developing a National Data Strategy, which is a draft that will provide a framework once finalised and approved.

The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance's permanent secretary said at a stakeholder engagement on 2026-03-12 or 13 that the government has ongoing efforts to establish a national data strategy to guide how data is governed, shared and used across government and the wider economy; the source gives no adoption or launch (published 2026-03-13, the event date being given only as that publication).

Uganda's Ministry of ICT and National Guidance says a draft National Data Strategy was formulated at a three-day workshop in Jinja in February 2024, presented to stakeholders in March 2024, with the final draft yet to be validated and the ministry at the pre-validation stage.
